text:
With a peace deal between the U.S. and Iran potentially closer than ever, questions now turn to the particulars of the agreement and what those are. In a social media post made this weekend, President Donald Trump said Iran has given up the prospects of obtaining a nuclear weapon, whether by developing one, purchasing it, or through other means. LiveNOW’s Andy Mac is learning the latest on the ongoing Iran war with Caitlin Doornbos, a Washington correspondent with the New York Post.

Posted June 14, 2026 5:31pm EDT
